item: Calendar feed store: an unreadable store is logged instead of reading as empty in silence (R386, R397)
summary: _load_json returned an empty store for a file that existed but could not be read (torn JSON, an OSError) with no word anywhere, and the next save replaced it: measured on a torn calendar_feed_imports.json holding one imported event, after a restore-merge of one new event only the new event remained. It now logs one warning naming the store file and the exception class only (nothing of the store's content). Behaviour is unchanged and the next save still replaces a damaged store; keeping the damaged bytes is a user proposal (item 31).
